Final: Suns 113 – Clippers 108. Wrong winner: it had Clippers at 88%, and Suns (12%) won.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Suns came in with a 8% above average attack and a 14% leakier than average defense (0-6, 118.7 scored and 129.2 allowed a game over 6 games), worth about 12 and 12 games of evidence. Projected to score 108.1, they scored 113 (+4.9 points, 5% over); projected to allow 122.2, they allowed 108 (−14.2 points, 12% under).

Clippers came in with a 12% above average attack and a 10% leakier than average defense (4-1, 122.4 scored and 119.6 allowed a game over 5 games), worth about 10 and 10 games of evidence. Projected to score 122.2, they scored 108 (−14.2 points, 12% under); projected to allow 108.1, they allowed 113 (+4.9 points, 5% over).

The bigger miss was Clippers' scoring (-14.2 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 221 against 230.3 projected (-9.3), about the 28th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±16).

Margin: Suns by 5 against Clippers by 14.1 projected, about the 6th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin; there were no odds to check the projection against.

The projection missed by a lot, so those flags likely mattered here.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.972 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -20.3 points. It counts toward Hoops+ scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 93 graded Hoops+ games the algo now scales scoring ×1.018 and gives home teams -1.2 points. Team corrections so far: Suns attack ×1.009, defense ×1.022 (6 games); Clippers attack ×1.005, defense ×0.999 (5 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 19.1 points), no bet.
